issues.description: The problem statement requires implementing init_world(width, height), but the template does not provide a stub for init_world. The solution repository adds init_world but only reads the first argument (width) and ignores height (comment: 'Only handles width'), producing a mismatch between the specified two-parameter signature and the actual handling in the solution/template.
issues.suggestedFix: Provide a consistent function signature and implementation across artifacts. Either (A) add a clear init_world stub to the template with the two-argument convention (width, height) and implement it so it reads both parameters (e.g. access [esp+4] and [esp+8] in cdecl) and sets the dimensions, and update the solution to handle both width and height; or (B) if only width is intended, update the problem statement to state init_world(width) only. Ensure the solution, template, and problem description all use the same parameter list and document how arguments are accessed in assembly.
